questions: Did the facial flushing come with itching or hives (raised, itchy welts) or any swelling of the lips/eyelids?
Did the flushing/rash start within minutes to 2 hours after eating a specific food or taking a new medication (like antibiotics), and if so, what was it?
Did he have any trouble breathing, wheezing, or tightness in his throat during or right after the episode?
answers: Yes—my rash itching is 10/10, and my cheeks suddenly turned red. I don’t know about swelling of the lips/eyelids.
Yes. I ate dark-fleshed fish (such as tuna) or Swiss cheese before the reaction occurred.
I don’t know. I also had lightheadedness/dizziness or felt like I was about to faint, and my heart was beating fast with palpitations.
